abstract: Muscle cell differentiation was analysed by two-dimensional gel electrophoresis of newly synthesized proteins compared in two parallel systems: in mouse teratocarcinoma-derived tumors that became restricted in their developmental potential to the formation of muscle-like cells and in developing limbs of the early mouse fetus. Muscle cell differentiation in teratocarcinomas was found to be reflected by both a marked decrease in the rate of synthesis of about 12% (119 proteins) of the resolved polypeptides and a pronounced increase in the synthesis of another large set of proteins (83 proteins). The majority of the newly acquired proteins (46 proteins) were also detected in fetal brain and muscle tissue. These proteins are considered to be those which accompany differentiation in general, regardless of cell type, as e.g. ubiquitously occurring structural proteins. Their expression in the muscle cells of the tumors may reflect the normal aspect of this particular differentiation pathway. Five polypeptides were found to appear specifically in both myogenic tumors and developing limbs, but not during brain formation and were tentatively termed muscle-specific proteins (MSP). The identification of differentiation-related proteins in muscle development will allow us to analyse differentiation in early development in molecular terms.
abstract_ja: マウス奇形癌由来で筋様細胞のみに分化が限定された腫瘍と、発生中のマウス胎児の肢芽において、新たに合成されるタンパク質を二次元ゲル電気泳動で比較した。筋細胞分化は、解析された約12%（119種）のポリペプチドの合成速度の顕著な低下と、別の多数のタンパク質（83種）の顕著な増加として示された。新たに獲得されたタンパク質の大半（46種）は、胎児の脳と筋組織でも検出された。これらは細胞種を問わず分化に伴うタンパク質、例えば普遍的に存在する構造タンパク質と考えられる。腫瘍の筋細胞でのその発現は、この分化経路の正常な側面を反映している可能性がある。5種のポリペプチドは、筋原性腫瘍と発生中の肢芽の両方に特異的に出現したが、脳の形成時には出現しなかった。これらを筋特異的タンパク質（MSP）と暫定的に命名した。筋発生における分化関連タンパク質の同定により、初期発生の分化を分子レベルで解析できると考えられる。
